fill_missing_permissions: fill missing permission keys in a permissions dict using default permissions as a template
get_permissions: get all permissions for a user by combining permissions from all groups they belong to
has_permission: check if a user has a specific hierarchical permission key across their groups and defaults
has_access: check if a user or their groups have read or write access to a resource via access control config
get_users_with_access: get all users who have read or write access to a resource based on group and user id permissions
